achievements.name: First Partner
achievements.detail: Choose Sprigatito, Fuecoco, or Quaxly and begin the term at Naranja Academy.

achievements.name: First Catch
achievements.detail: Catch a wild Pokémon and add its entry to the Pokédex.

achievements.name: First Badge
achievements.detail: Defeat a gym leader and earn your first Paldea Gym Badge.

achievements.name: Eight Badges
achievements.detail: Beat all eight gym leaders and collect every Paldea Gym Badge.

achievements.name: Titan Toppled
achievements.detail: Win a battle against one of the Titan Pokémon on the Path of Legends.

achievements.name: Path of Legends
achievements.detail: Defeat every Titan Pokémon and finish that storyline.

achievements.name: Star Base
achievements.detail: Clear a Team Star base by beating its crew and the boss's team.

achievements.name: Starfall Street
achievements.detail: Shut down every Team Star base and finish that storyline.

achievements.name: Terastallize
achievements.detail: Use the Tera Orb in battle so a Pokémon crowns itself and changes type.

achievements.name: New Ride
achievements.detail: Unlock another way for Koraidon to travel, such as dashing, swimming, or gliding.

achievements.name: Paldea Champion
achievements.detail: Win the Champion Assessment and take the title of Paldea champion.

achievements.name: Final Chapter
achievements.detail: Clear the last story battle after the league, the titans, and Team Star are all done.
